context: Two coworkers debrief after an inventory review
purpose: Teach: セールス/トピック/モジュール/ステーション/入荷/調節/短期間/新設

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 棚卸し、お疲れ。今期のセールスは思ったより伸びてたな。
lines.en: Good work on the inventory. Sales this quarter grew more than I expected.
lines.style: Casual senior coworker, relaxed and appreciative tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。ただ、主要トピックは欠品の多さでしたよね。
lines.en: Thank you. But the main topic was really the frequent stockouts, right?
lines.style: Polite junior tone, slightly concerned and analytical

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうそう。特に新商品の入荷が全然追いついてなかった。
lines.en: Exactly. The incoming shipments of new products couldn't keep up at all.
lines.style: Agreeing casually, leaning into shared frustration

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫の管理モジュールを入れ替えれば、もう少し在庫を調節できると思います。
lines.en: If we swap the warehouse management module, we could regulate stock better.
lines.style: Suggesting a concrete fix in measured, professional Japanese

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど。駅前のサービスステーションみたいに、自動で発注できるやつか。
lines.en: I see. Like that service station near the station that auto-orders things?
lines.style: Curious, drawing a real-world comparison conversationally

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。短期間で導入できるプランもあるそうなので、検討する価値はあります。
lines.en: Yes. There are plans deployable quickly, so it's worth seriously considering.
lines.style: Professional pitch with mild enthusiasm, business register

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: じゃあ来月新設するチームに、そのテストを任せてみようか。
lines.en: Then let's have the newly established team next month handle the trial.
lines.style: Decisive senior making a delegation call, friendly authority

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ぜひ。提案書、明日までにまとめておきますね。
lines.en: Please do. I'll have the proposal document ready by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Eager and dependable closing remark from junior employee
